items.statement: Design and operate the air handling system so that each designated classified area achieves its assigned Grade A, B, C or D air, and be able to describe the steps taken.
items.quote: 18.3 | WHO TRS-961 ANNEXE-06 | Specify the steps taken in air handling system to achieve the Grade A, B, C and D of air as per designated classified areas.

items.statement: Establish the recovery time of Grade B and C zones, measured from when personnel leave the room after operations end, and keep records of it.
items.quote: 18.4 | Sch-M | Specify the recovery time of B & C zone from the time of personnel leaving the room after completion of operations and verify the records in this regard.
items.condition: after personnel leave on completion of operations

items.statement: Challenge filling operations with simulation trials, including sterile media fills, first initially and then periodically.
items.quote: 18.5 | Sch-M | Specify whether filling operations are challenged initially and there after periodically by simulation trials including sterile media fill.

items.statement: Have a written media fill procedure that states its acceptance criteria.
items.quote: 18.6 | WHO TRS-961 ANNEXE-06 | Specify the procedure followed for medial fill and the acceptance criteria.

items.statement: Design media fill trials on the worst case, covering all interventions and activities that occur in normal operation as well as worst-case conditions.
items.quote: 18.7 | WHO TRS-961 ANNEXE-06 | Whether the medial fill trial is based on worst case situation taking into consideration all interventions, activities occurring during normal activity as well as worst case.

items.statement: Repeat process simulation tests at defined intervals and after any significant change to the HVAC system, equipment or process.
items.quote: 18.8 | WHO TRS-961 ANNEXE-06 | Whether simulation tests are repeated at defined intervals and after any significant modification to HVAC system, equipment or process.
items.condition: after significant modification to HVAC, equipment or process

items.statement: Define and maintain the number of air changes in Grade A/B and Grade C areas.
items.quote: 18.9 | Sch-M | Specify the number of air changes in Grade A/B and Grade C areas.

items.statement: Define and maintain the air velocity at Grade A laminar air flow stations.
items.quote: 18.10 | Sch-M | Specify the air velocity maintained in Grade A Laminar Air Flow stations

items.statement: Maintain a defined pressure differential between areas of different environmental standards.
items.quote: 18.1 | Sch-M | Specify the differential pressure between areas of different environmental standards.

items.statement: Install suitable manometers to measure and verify air pressure differentials, and know their type.
items.quote: 18.1 | Sch-M | Specify type of manometer installed for measurement and verification of Air Pressure Differential.

items.statement: Assign a defined air classification to the final change room used to enter Grade A/B areas.
items.quote: 18.13 | WHO TRS-961 | Specify the air classification in final change room to enter A/B area.

items.statement: Have a defined method for cleaning and sterilizing garments used in clean areas.
items.quote: 20.2 | WHO TRS-961 ANNEXE-06 | Specify how the garments used in clean areas are cleaned and sterilized.

items.statement: Have numbered SOPs for sanitation of sterile processing facilities.
items.quote: 21.1 | Sch-M | Specify the SOP followed for sanitation of sterile processing facilities and mention the SOP nos.

items.statement: Give staff who sanitize critical areas specific training for that task.
items.quote: 21.2 | Sch-M | Specify whether employees carrying out the sanitation of critical areas are specially trained for this purpose.

items.statement: Keep training records for staff who sanitize critical areas.
items.quote: 21.3 | Sch-M | Verify the training records.

items.statement: Define the sanitizing agent or agents used.
items.quote: 21.4 | Sch-M | Specify the sanitizing agent/s used.

items.statement: Define the water quality used to prepare sanitising solutions.
items.quote: 21.5 | Sch-M | Specify the quality of water used for preparation of sanitising solution.

items.statement: Define the disinfectant used in hand sprays.
items.quote: 21.6 | Sch-M | Specify the disinfectant used for hand sprays?

items.statement: Before use, either membrane-filter disinfectant solutions into suitable sterile containers or sterilize them.
items.quote: 21.7 | Sch-M | Specify whether disinfectant solutions are filtered through membrane into suitable sterile containers or sterilized before use?

items.statement: Label diluted disinfectants with a use-before date based on microbiological data showing how long their germicidal properties last, and keep the supporting records.
items.quote: 21.8 | Sch-M | Specify whether the diluted disinfectants bear ‘use before’ labels based on microbiological establishment of their germicidal properties & verify the records

items.statement: Where critical areas are fumigated, define the fumigating agent and its concentration.
items.quote: 21.9 | Sch-M | Specify whether fumigation is carried out in critical areas. If yes, specify fumigating agent and its conc. used.

items.statement: Have a numbered SOP for fumigation.
items.quote: 21.10 | Sch-M | Specify whether any SOP exist for the purpose of fumigation if so mentioned the SOP nos.

items.statement: Have a defined cleaning procedure for critical areas.
items.quote: 21.1 | Sch-M | Specify the cleaning procedure of critical areas.

items.statement: Monitor particles in Grade A zones for the full duration of critical processing, including equipment assembly.
items.quote: 21.1 | WHO TRS-961 ANNEXE-06 | Specify whether particle monitoring in Grade A zones is undertaken for the full duration of critical processing including equipment assembly.

items.statement: Monitor particles in Grade B zones for the full duration of critical processing.
items.quote: 21.1 | WHO TRS-961 | Specify whether particle monitoring in Grade B zones is undertaken for the full duration of critical processing.

items.statement: Place the temperature probes used for controlling and/or recording at the positions found during validation (the coolest spot), check them where applicable against a second independent calibrated probe in the same position, and record temperature continuously through the cycle.
items.quote: 27.2 | Sch-M | Whether the position of temperature probes used for controlling and / or recording determined during validation and (where applicable) been checked against a second independent temperature probe located in the same position | NA | The temperature probe( RTD or thermocouple) was found placed at coolest spot determined during validation by independent calibrated prob. The temperature of same probe was found recorded and the recording is continuous through the cycle/ | The control probe was found not at exactly same position of coolest point. The temperature recording was found not continuous. The validation was found not performed by independent probe at the same position/suitable position that of control probe | NA

items.statement: Keep the sterilization temperature chart or thermograph as part of the batch record.
items.quote: 27.3 | Sch-M | Whether the chart forms a part of the batch record. | NA | Temperature Chart/ Thermograph was found part of batch record. | Temperature Chart/ Thermograph was found not part of batch record. Thermograph not preserved. | NA

items.statement: Validate sterilization cycles physically by thermal mapping of heat distribution and penetration, not only with biological and chemical indicators, and establish the cycle parameters (for dry heat: temperature, duration, positive pressure; for tunnels: temperature, duration, conveyor speed).
items.quote: 27.4 | Sch-M | Whether sterilization cycle validated only by biological indicator and chemical indicators or physical validation is also carried out | NA | Sterilization cycle validated physically by thermal mapping along with biological and chemical indicators. During validation sterilization parameters are established e.g. 1) For DHS Temperature, duration, positive pressure 2) For tunnel , temperature,duration,speed of conveyor etc. | Physical verification by thermal mapping for heat distribution and heat penetration was found not carried out. | The sterilizers are not studied for heat distribution / penetration. Effectiveness of sterilization process not established by using microbial spore indicators.

items.statement: Determine separately for each load type the lag time needed to reach sterilizing temperature before sterilizing time is counted, and state it in the routine sterilization SOP.
items.quote: 27.5 | Sch-M | Whether the time allowed reaching the required temperature before commencing the measurement of sterilizing time, separately determined for each type of load. | NA | Lag time was found determined for all load types. The lag rimes was found specified in SOP for routine sterilization | The sterilization time is measured without considered established lag time. | NA

items.statement: Take adequate precautions to protect the load while it cools after the high-temperature phase of a heat sterilization cycle.
items.quote: 27.6 | Sch-M | Are adequate precautions taken to protect the load during cooling after it has gone through the high temperature phase of a heat sterilization cycle | NA | Adequate precaution was found taken to protect the load during cooling after it has gone through the high temperature phase of a heat sterilization cycle. | No adequate precaution was found taken to protect the load during cooling after it has gone through the high temperature phase of a heat sterilization cycle. | NA

items.statement: Where cooling uses a fluid or gas that contacts the product, sterilize it (for cooling air, filter it through HEPA filters).
items.quote: 27.7 | Sch-M | In case the cooling is affected with any fluid or gas in contact with the product , is it sterilized. | NA | Cooling air was found filtered through HEPA filters | Cooling air was found not filtered through HEPA filters | NA
items.condition: if cooling fluid or gas contacts the product

items.statement: Fit sterilizer air inlets and outlets with bacteria-retaining (HEPA) filters.
items.quote: 27.8 | Sch-M | Whether the equipment air inlet and outlets been provided with bacteria retaining filters | NA | Inlet and outlet was found provided with HEPA filters. | Inlet and outlet was found not provided with HEPA filters. | NA
